description: This is a unit test class for the vCal class in SuiteCRM, testing its methods related to calendar and vCal operations.

classes.name: vCalTest
classes.description: A PHPUnit test class for validating the functionality of the vCal class methods related to iCalendar operations and SuiteCRM calendar integration.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initial setup before each test, including calling parent setup and initializing the current_user global.

methods.name: testvCal
methods.description: Tests instantiation and basic properties of a vCal bean.

methods.name: testget_summary_text
methods.description: Tests the get_summary_text method behavior with and without the name property.

methods.name: testfill_in_additional_list_fields
methods.description: Ensures fill_in_additional_list_fields executes without exceptions (method not implemented).

methods.name: testfill_in_additional_detail_fields
methods.description: Ensures fill_in_additional_detail_fields executes without exceptions (method not implemented).

methods.name: testget_freebusy_lines_cache
methods.description: Tests the get_freebusy_lines_cache method output for correct start and end lines.

methods.name: testcreate_sugar_freebusy
methods.description: Tests the create_sugar_freebusy method for generating free/busy info.

methods.name: testget_vcal_freebusy
methods.description: Tests the get_vcal_freebusy method output format.

methods.name: testcache_sugar_vcal
methods.description: Tests the cache_sugar_vcal static method invocation without exceptions.

methods.name: testcache_sugar_vcal_freebusy
methods.description: Tests the cache_sugar_vcal_freebusy static method invocation.

methods.name: testfold_ical_lines
methods.description: Validates the folding of iCalendar lines with short and long inputs.

methods.name: testcreate_ical_array_from_string
methods.description: Checks parsing of iCalendar string into array for correctness.

methods.name: testcreate_ical_string_from_array
methods.description: Validates serialization of iCalendar array back into string format.

methods.name: testescape_ical_chars
methods.description: Ensures special characters are correctly escaped for iCalendar.

methods.name: testunescape_ical_chars
methods.description: Ensures escaped characters are properly unescaped.

methods.name: testget_ical_event
methods.description: Generates and verifies ICAL VEVENT string for a meeting and user.
